title: 機械工学専門実験・演習Ａ
subtitle: Mechanical Engineering Major Lab/ Exercises A
teachers:
SUGIMOTO Yasuhiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Acquire sufficient understanding and application of specialized subjects, such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, mechanics of materials and mechanical dynamics.
(2) Acquire technical writing skills.
(3) Learn how to create presentation materials and presentation scripts.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:
Thermodynamics: temperature measurement, heat pump, and coefficient of performance
Fluid mechanics: flow rate, friction factor, and flow around circular cylinder
Mechanics of materials: tensile tests and bending tests
Mechanical dynamics: vibration measurement methods, dynamic vibration systems, and dynamic absorbers

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class.
Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.

[Note] Students will be divided into four groups and rotate through the four experimental themes listed above. Group allocations and the dates for each experimental theme will be announced during the guidance session. Please check the e-syllabus for the instruction manual and preparatory assignments for each experiment topic. Please prepare and bring a notebook specifically for specialized experiments.

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize experimental results.
Be able to actively participate in experiments based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to consider the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to evaluate the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to use the kinematics model to determine the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
Be able to submit and explain your experimental results as a technical report.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Create thorough technical reports on experimental results using a computer.
(2) Proactively participate systematically in class experiments based on the related specialized subjects.
(3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects.
(4) Use the kinematics model to compare experimental and theoretical results.
(5) Explain the experimental results in a thorough technical report and submit it for evaluation.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Create technical reports on experimental results using a computer.
(2) Participate the class experiments based on the related specialized subjects.
(3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects.
(4) Compare the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
(5) Explain the experimental results in a technical report and submit it for evaluation.
